### nishgfx_adapter_release

```ts
const nishgfx_adapter_release: (

```

<a id="nishgfx_adapter_request" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_adapter_request

Request an adapter.

```ts
const nishgfx_adapter_request: (
  instance: NishGfxInstance,
  surface: NishGfxSurface | null,
  power: u32,
) => NishGfxAdapter | null
```

<scalar-field name="instance" type="NishGfxInstance" required>

the instance to request it from

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="surface" type="NishGfxSurface | null" required>

a surface the adapter must be able to present to, or null

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="power" type="u32" required>

a WGPUPowerPreference

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxAdapter | null">

the adapter, or null (and an instance error is queued) on failure

</scalar-field>

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_bind_group_desc_buffer" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_bind_group_desc_buffer

Bind size bytes of buffer at offset to `binding`; size 0 binds the rest of
the buffer from offset.

```ts
const nishgfx_bind_group_desc_buffer: (
  desc: NishGfxBindGroupDesc,
  binding: u32,
  buffer: NishGfxBuffer,
  offset: u64,
  size: u64,
) => i32
```

<scalar-field name="desc" type="NishGfxBindGroupDesc" required>

the builder

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="binding" type="u32" required>

the binding number

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="buffer" type="NishGfxBuffer" required>

the buffer bound

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="offset" type="u64" required>

the byte offset into buffer

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="size" type="u64" required>

the bytes bound, or 0 for the rest of the buffer

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="i32">

0, or -1 once the builder holds 16

</scalar-field>

```ts
const nishgfx_buffer_new: (

  size: u64,
  usage: u32,
  mapped_at_creation: u32,

) => NishGfxBuffer | null
```

<scalar-field name="device" type="NishGfxDevice" required>

the device it lives on

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="size" type="u64" required>

its size in bytes

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="usage" type="u32" required>

WGPUBufferUsage bits

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="mapped_at_creation" type="u32" required>

nonzero to start it mapped

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="label" type="string | null" required>

a debug label, or null

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxBuffer | null">

the buffer, or null when wgpu-native answers none

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_device_release" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_device_release

Release a device. Release every buffer, shader, pipeline, bind group,
offscreen target and surface made from the device first: one used after
this can report an error into the freed device.

```ts
const nishgfx_device_release: (
  device: NishGfxDevice,
) => void
```

<scalar-field name="device" type="NishGfxDevice" required>

the device to release

</scalar-field>


<scalar-field name="instance" type="NishGfxInstance" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="adapter" type="NishGfxAdapter" required>

the adapter to request it from

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxDevice | null">

the device, or null (and an instance error is queued) on failure

</scalar-field>

NUL-terminated and cut to cap - 1 bytes.

```ts
const nishgfx_instance_error_next: (
  instance: NishGfxInstance,
  msg: u8[],
  cap: u64,
) => i32
```

<scalar-field name="instance" type="NishGfxInstance" required>

the instance whose ring is drained

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="msg" type="u8[]" required>

the buffer the message is copied into

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="cap" type="u64" required>

the bytes msg holds

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="i32">

the error's kind, a NISHGFX_ERROR_* value, or 0 when the ring is empty

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_instance_release" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_instance_release

Release an instance. Release it last: every surface, adapter and device
made from it keeps it, and a device's readback drives events through it.

```ts
const nishgfx_instance_release: (
  instance: NishGfxInstance,
) => void
```

<scalar-field name="instance" type="NishGfxInstance" required>

the instance to release

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_offscreen_create" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_offscreen_create

A width x height RGBA8Unorm render target with readback; needs no window
and initialises no SDL video.

```ts
const nishgfx_offscreen_create: (
  device: NishGfxDevice,
  width: u32,
  height: u32,
) => NishGfxOffscreen | null
```

<scalar-field name="device" type="NishGfxDevice" required>

the device it lives on

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="width" type="u32" required>

the width in pixels, 1 to 16384

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="height" type="u32" required>

the height in pixels, 1 to 16384

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxOffscreen | null">

the target, or null for a side outside 1 to 16384 or when the
device answers none

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_offscreen_read" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_offscreen_read

Copy the target's pixels, width * 4 bytes per row, top row first, into dst.

```ts
const nishgfx_offscreen_read: (
  offscreen: NishGfxOffscreen,
  dst: u8[],
  cap: u64,
) => i32
```

<scalar-field name="offscreen" type="NishGfxOffscreen" required>

the target to read

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="dst" type="u8[]" required>

the buffer the pixels are copied into

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="cap" type="u64" required>

the bytes dst holds

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="i32">

0; -1 when cap < width * height * 4 (dst untouched); -2 when the
map fails (an error is queued on the device)

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_offscreen_release" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_offscreen_release

Release an offscreen target.

```ts
const nishgfx_offscreen_release: (
  offscreen: NishGfxOffscreen,
) => void
```

<scalar-field name="offscreen" type="NishGfxOffscreen" required>

the target to release

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_offscreen_view" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_offscreen_view

The target's view, valid until the offscreen is released.

```ts

  offscreen: NishGfxOffscreen,
```

<scalar-field name="offscreen" type="NishGfxOffscreen" required>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxView | null">

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_pass_begin" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_pass_begin

A render pass on one color view. load != 0 keeps the view's contents;
otherwise it is cleared to (r, g, b, a).

```ts
const nishgfx_pass_begin: (
  encoder: NishGfxEncoder,
  view: NishGfxView,
  load: u32,
  r: f64,
  g: f64,
  b: f64,
  a: f64,
) => NishGfxPass | null
```

<scalar-field name="encoder" type="NishGfxEncoder" required>

the encoder that records it

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="view" type="NishGfxView" required>

the color view it draws into

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="load" type="u32" required>

nonzero to keep the view's contents

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="r" type="f64" required>

the clear color's red, 0 to 1

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="g" type="f64" required>

the clear color's green, 0 to 1

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="b" type="f64" required>

the clear color's blue, 0 to 1

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="a" type="f64" required>

the clear color's alpha, 0 to 1

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxPass | null">

the pass, or null for a null encoder or view or when it cannot begin

</scalar-field>

### nishgfx_pass_draw

Draw vertices with the pass's pipeline.

the pass

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="vertices" type="u32" required>

how many vertices to draw

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="instances" type="u32" required>

how many instances to draw

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="first_vertex" type="u32" required>

the first vertex's index

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="first_instance" type="u32" required>

the first instance's index

</scalar-field>

Build the pipeline and free the builder, either way.

<a id="nishgfx_pipeline_desc_new" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_pipeline_desc_new

A render pipeline builder: one vertex buffer of `stride` bytes (0 for no
vertex buffer), one color target of `color_format`, triangle list.

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="fs_entry" type="string" required>

the fragment stage's entry point, NUL-terminated

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="color_format" type="u32" required>

the color target's WGPUTextureFormat

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="stride" type="u64" required>

the vertex buffer's stride in bytes, or 0 for none

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxPipelineDesc | null">

the builder, or null when memory runs out

</scalar-field>

</scalar-field>

### nishgfx_shader_release

Release a shader module.

```ts
const nishgfx_shader_release: (
  shader: NishGfxShader,
) => void
```

<scalar-field name="shader" type="NishGfxShader" required>

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_surface_acquire" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_surface_acquire

The next frame's view, which lives until nishgfx_surface_present().

```ts
const nishgfx_surface_acquire: (
  surface: NishGfxSurface,
) => NishGfxView | null
```

<scalar-field name="surface" type="NishGfxSurface" required>

the configured surface

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxView | null">

the view, or null to skip this frame: an outdated, lost or
timed-out surface is reconfigured at the window's pixel size, or left
until a frame where that size is above 0; any other failure queues a
device error

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_surface_configure" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_surface_configure

Configure a surface for width x height. vsync != 0 is Fifo; otherwise
Mailbox, then Immediate, then Fifo, whichever the surface offers first.

```ts
const nishgfx_surface_configure: (
  surface: NishGfxSurface,
  adapter: NishGfxAdapter,
  device: NishGfxDevice,
  width: u32,
  height: u32,
  vsync: u32,
) => i32
```

<scalar-field name="surface" type="NishGfxSurface" required>

the surface to configure

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="adapter" type="NishGfxAdapter" required>

the adapter the device came from

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="device" type="NishGfxDevice" required>

the device that draws into the surface

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="width" type="u32" required>

the width in pixels

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="height" type="u32" required>

the height in pixels

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="vsync" type="u32" required>

nonzero to wait for the display

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="i32">

0, or -1 (and a device error is queued) for a 0 side or a surface
with no format

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_surface_create" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_surface_create

A surface on the window, through Metal, Wayland or X11 as SDL's current
video driver says.

```ts
const nishgfx_surface_create: (
  instance: NishGfxInstance,
  window: NishGfxWindow,
) => NishGfxSurface | null
```

<scalar-field name="instance" type="NishGfxInstance" required>

the instance the surface is made from

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="window" type="NishGfxWindow" required>

the window it presents into

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="NishGfxSurface | null">

the surface, or null (and an instance error is queued) on any
other video driver or failure

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_surface_format" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_surface_format

The texture format nishgfx_surface_configure() picked.

```ts
const nishgfx_surface_format: (
  surface: NishGfxSurface,
) => u32
```

<scalar-field name="surface" type="NishGfxSurface" required>

the surface to ask

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="u32">

a WGPUTextureFormat, or 0 for a null surface

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_surface_present" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_surface_present

Present the frame nishgfx_surface_acquire() answered.

```ts
const nishgfx_surface_present: (
  surface: NishGfxSurface,

```

<scalar-field name="surface" type="NishGfxSurface" required>

the surface to present

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_surface_release" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_surface_release

Release a surface.

```ts
const nishgfx_surface_release: (
  surface: NishGfxSurface,
) => void
```

<scalar-field name="surface" type="NishGfxSurface" required>

the surface to release

</scalar-field>

<a id="nishgfx_window_create" style="scroll-margin-top: 65px"></a>

### nishgfx_window_create

An SDL3 window of width x height pixels.

```ts
const nishgfx_window_create: (
  title: string,
  width: u32,
  height: u32,
) => NishGfxWindow | null
```

<scalar-field name="title" type="string" required>

the window's title, NUL-terminated UTF-8

## Limits

<scalar-card title="255" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_ERROR_MESSAGE_MAX: i32`

The longest message an entry keeps, without its NUL.

</scalar-card>

## Constants

<scalar-grid cols="2">

<scalar-card title="4" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST: i32`

The device was lost.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="3" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_ERROR_INTERNAL: i32`

A WebGPU internal error, or a failure of the shim's own.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="0" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_ERROR_NONE: i32`

No error was queued.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="2" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: i32`

A WebGPU out-of-memory error.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="16" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_ERROR_RING: i32`

The error ring's size, per instance and per device.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="1" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_ERROR_VALIDATION: i32`

A WebGPU validation error.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="2" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_KEY_DOWN: i32`

A key went down.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="3" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_KEY_UP: i32`

A key came up.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="5" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_MOUSE_DOWN: i32`

A mouse button went down.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="4" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_MOUSE_MOVE: i32`

The pointer moved.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="6" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_MOUSE_UP: i32`

A mouse button came up.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="0" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_NONE: i32`

No event was queued.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="1" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_QUIT: i32`

The window was asked to close.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="8" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_RESIZED: i32`

The window's pixel size changed.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="64" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_RING: i32`

The event ring's size, per window.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="7" icon="phosphor/regular/hash">

`NISHGFX_EVENT_WHEEL: i32`

The wheel turned.
